svg.title: Where the risk sits — Acme Checkout
svg.desc: Two five-by-five grids of likelihood against impact for Acme Checkout, as of 2026-09-13: where each vector sits now, and where it would sit with nothing done. Each cell names its risk band beside a stripe in its colour.
svg.text: A mitigated vector placed by the risk its control leaves
Every vector placed by its inherent rating
